views.name: replace_with_type
views.note: Every private value replaced by its type (the default of many redaction tools).

views.name: alias_per_run
views.note: Consistent first-appearance aliases within each run; text masked.

views.name: hash_per_event
views.note: Keyed hash with a fresh salt per event: the same person differs between spans.

views.name: hash_per_run
views.note: Keyed hash salted per run. In production set key_env to a secret variable.

views.name: times_bucket_60
views.note: Aliases plus times floored to the minute (60 s).

views.name: times_rank
views.note: Aliases plus times replaced by their order within the run.

views.name: no_ticket_status
views.note: A minimal log that drops the ticket's status fields.

views.name: role_masked
views.note: Aliases plus the agent role masked.

views.name: my_redactor
views.note: Your own redactor as a command (see my_redactor.py). It declares nothing, like most real tools.
